name: claude-gauge
title: Claude Gauge
description: Keyboard-only dashboard for Claude Code subscription limits (5-hour & weekly) and Anthropic API token/cost usage.
author: zzaisang

commands.name: session
commands.title: Claude Session
commands.description: 5-hour & weekly subscription usage with reset countdown and burn rate

preferences.name: adminApiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Admin key (sk-ant-admin01-…) → org token usage & cost, OR a standard key (sk-ant-api…) → rate-limit status only. Stored securely in the macOS Keychain and used only for the API Usage command.

preferences.name: currency
preferences.title: Currency
preferences.description: Display currency for cost figures. The Anthropic API always returns USD; KRW is an approximate conversion.

preferences.name: usdKrwRate
preferences.title: USD to KRW Rate
preferences.description: Approximate exchange rate used when Currency is set to KRW.

preferences.name: monthlyBudgetUsd
preferences.title: Monthly Budget (USD)
preferences.description: Monthly budget in USD. When set, shows a gauge of this month's cumulative cost against it. Leave blank to show the running total only.

preferences.name: ccusageRunner
preferences.title: ccusage Runner
preferences.description: Package runner used to execute the ccusage CLI for token/cost details.

preferences.name: claudeConfigDir
preferences.title: Claude Config Directory
preferences.description: Defaults to ~/.claude. Override if your CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is elsewhere.

preferences.name: apiUsageConfigDir
preferences.title: API Usage Config Dir (per-key)
preferences.description: A CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR dedicated to this API key (e.g. ~/.claude-work). Point it at a directory used only with that key so the API Usage screen aggregates just that key's usage. Leave blank to use the general Claude Config Directory (or ~/.claude).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
